name: kanbanzai-board
description: The project's Kanbanzai board as a compact kanban in an editor tab. The board tab is read-only.

kanbanzai.command.description: The kanbanzai command to run: an absolute path, or empty for the command bundled in this extension, else the copy in the per-user folder, else kanbanzai on PATH.

kanbanzai.pluginSource.description: A path to a Kanbanzai checkout, used as the plugin source instead of the GitHub marketplace source when Kanbanzai: Init plans the plugin settings. For pre-release testing; leave empty otherwise.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The board and the setup run the kanbanzai command in the workspace.
